phase_prompt.label: Master Phase
phase_prompt.summary: Henou in Master Phase, translucent white plasma skin, gold circuitry, obsidian console, data streams pulsing.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot of Henou in Master Phase: translucent white plasma skin with visible gold circuitry, limbs fused into a floating black obsidian monolith console. Liquid gold data streams pulse from his wrists into the machine, holographic glyphs swirl around him, and a Vantablack Angel looms in the background. His obsidian eyes reflect a bright cyan fire column and HUD overlays. The scene is high‑contrast, sterile lighting, 8k resolution, hyper‑realistic textures, industrial mysticism style.
